name: Motor vehicle dealers and repairers
what: Hold a state dealer licence to sell vehicles, a repairer licence in some states, and meet vehicle standards and repair information rules.

layers.who: State fair trading or motor industry regulator
Commonwealth (road vehicle standards, repair information scheme)

basis.source: Building a skilled and adaptable workforce: Inquiry report
basis.quote: motor vehicle repairers in New South Wales, Western Australia and the Australian Capital Territory

issues.what: A licence to repair motor vehicles is required in only some states.
